promptStrategy.cloud: JSON-mode + a tool-listing system prompt (mirrors the production router)
promptStrategy.gemini: Gemma on the Gemini API: tool list + query in one user turn (no system role / tools), JSON reply parsed
promptStrategy.webllm: FunctionGemma native declaration tokens. The 270M rows are an ablation LADDER on the SAME untuned model: candidate set k=8 vs k=3, full vs compact declarations, and free vs grammar-constrained (XGrammar, name∈candidates) decoding — isolating how much infra alone (no fine-tune) recovers.

method.scoring: tool SELECTION accuracy — exact registry tool name (normalized); irrelevance = no call. Registry examples carry no annotated args, so argument accuracy is not scored (n/a).
method.coverageNote: Cases are every registry tool's first bilingual example (EN+BG). Cloud models see the FULL tool set in context (route among all tools); small in-browser models see a retrieved candidate set (the realistic two-stage architecture).

tools.name: parliamentSeats

tools.name: seatsHistory

tools.name: partyResult

tools.name: candidateResult

tools.name: machineVoteShare

tools.name: turnout

tools.name: compareElections

tools.name: machineVoteSeries

tools.name: turnoutSeries
tools.description: Voter turnout across the last N elections.

tools.name: partyTimeline

tools.name: pollAccuracy

tools.name: agencyProfile

tools.name: latestPolls
tools.description: The latest poll by party (incl. "if elections were now").

tools.name: latestPresidentialPoll
tools.description: The latest presidential poll by candidate (a separate corpus from the parliamentary polls).

tools.name: agencyPolls
tools.description: One agency's poll history: party support across all its polls over time (trend).

tools.name: agencyAccuracyHistory
tools.description: One agency's accuracy over time: mean error vs the result by election (trend).

tools.name: accuracyTrend
tools.description: Pollster accuracy compared across elections over time (trend, one line per agency).

tools.name: regionBreakdown
tools.description: A party's result by oblast in one election (where it's strong/weak).

tools.name: municipalityBreakdown
tools.description: A party's result by municipality within one oblast (map + ranking).

tools.name: municipalityWinners
tools.description: Results by municipality in one oblast: the leading party in each (list + map).

tools.name: settlementWinners
tools.description: Results by settlement in one municipality: the leading party in each (list + map).

tools.name: sectionWinners

tools.name: sectionResults

tools.name: sectionHistory
tools.description: How one polling section (by its number) voted over time — vote share per party across elections (multi-line trend).

tools.name: sectionRiskHistory
tools.description: Risk profile of one polling section (by its number) over time — risk-screening band per election plus whether it is a flagged problem section (Roma neighborhood) or a persistent cross-election cluster.

tools.name: settlementResults
tools.description: Results in one settlement (village/town): votes and % per party + turnout.

tools.name: settlementHistory
tools.description: How one settlement voted over time — vote share per party across elections (multi-line trend).

tools.name: municipalityResults
tools.description: Results in one municipality: votes and % per party + turnout.

tools.name: municipalityHistory
tools.description: How one municipality voted over time — vote share per party across elections (multi-line trend).

tools.name: regionResults
tools.description: Results in one region/oblast, optionally filtered to one party: votes and % per party + turnout (incl. Sofia city = its three MIR combined).

tools.name: regionResultsTrend
tools.description: How one region/oblast voted over time — vote share per party across elections (multi-line trend).

tools.name: settlementBreakdown
tools.description: A party's result by settlement within one municipality (map + ranking).

tools.name: electionAnomalies
tools.description: Anomaly signals for one election (recounts, machine corrections, problem sections).

tools.name: flashMemoryByParty
tools.description: Machine count vs flash-memory (СУЕМГ) difference by party — which parties gained/lost votes.

tools.name: machineVoteByParty
tools.description: Machine vs paper voting share by party — which parties vote on machines.

tools.name: wastedVotesByParty
tools.description: Wasted votes (below the 4% threshold) by party — which parties lost the most votes.

tools.name: recountByParty
tools.description: Per-party vote change after a manual recount (only elections with a recount, e.g. Oct 2024).

tools.name: regionHistory
tools.description: Voter turnout in one oblast across all elections.

tools.name: voteTransitions
tools.description: Statistically estimated vote flows between two consecutive elections from aggregate section results. It does not track how an individual voted.

tools.name: localCouncilVoteShare
tools.description: Municipal council vote share by party (national).

tools.name: localMayorsWon
tools.description: Mayors won by party (national).

tools.name: localCouncilTrend
tools.description: Council vote-share trend by party across the local-election cycles 2007–2023.

tools.name: localVoteFlows
tools.description: Vote transitions between local elections (municipal councils) — where party votes moved between two cycles.

tools.name: localPrevoteFlow
tools.description: Vote flow from the last parliamentary vote before the local election into the council ballot — where the national-election votes went locally.

tools.name: localPlaceTrend
tools.description: Council vote-share trend by party for one settlement or Sofia район across the local cycles (+ the winning mayor per cycle).

tools.name: localMayorsTrend
tools.description: Mayors-won trend by party across the local-election cycles 2007–2023.

tools.name: localOblastMayors
tools.description: Mayors won by party within a single province (oblast).

tools.name: localMunicipality
tools.description: One município: elected mayor, council, turnout.

tools.name: localMayorRace
tools.description: Full mayoral candidate ranking in a município.

tools.name: localMayorSections
tools.description: Where the elected mayor ran strongest and weakest, by polling station.

tools.name: localMayorHistory
tools.description: A município's elected mayors across local cycles (the last mayors).

tools.name: localSubMayors
tools.description: District mayors (Sofia) or settlement (kmetstvo) mayors of a município.

tools.name: localCouncil
tools.description: Municipal council seats by party.

tools.name: chmiEvents
tools.description: Extraordinary (partial/new) local elections feed, with turnout.

tools.name: budgetOverview
tools.description: State budget — annual plan and cash execution: revenue, expenditure, balance. Defaults to latest available year, including partial years.

tools.name: ngoOverview
tools.description: Non-profit organisations (NPOs) — overview: count, public + external funding, types.

tools.name: ngoTopFunded
tools.description: Best-funded NGOs — organisations with the most external funding (EU, state subsidies).

tools.name: ngoConflictAwarders
tools.description: K-Index: authorities whose contracts most flow to politically-linked suppliers (incl. via NGO boards).

tools.name: ngoRiskSignals
tools.description: NGOs by public-interest signal — how many win contracts, receive EU funds, subsidies or external funding.

tools.name: ngoBySignal
tools.description: Top NGOs carrying a specific signal (public contracts, EU funds, state subsidy, external funding, single bidder, large budget).

tools.name: budgetTrend
tools.description: State-budget trend — revenue and spending by year (completed fiscal years).

tools.name: institutionMaintenance
tools.description: Operating cost (издръжка) by institution — current spending less personnel, subsidies, interest and transfers, 2018–2026. With an institution → its trend; without → the biggest 2026-draft increases.

tools.name: simulateTaxChange
tools.description: Budget effect of a tax change (VAT, income tax, untaxed minimum, corporate, dividend, МОД cap) — scored revenue impact + a simulator deep link.

tools.name: budgetByFunction
tools.description: Historical general-government expenditure by function (COFOG), not the current budget plan.

tools.name: budgetFunction
tools.description: Spending on one budget function (e.g. health, defence, education): share + trend.

tools.name: nzokBudget
tools.description: NHIF (health-fund) budget by expenditure line — where the ~€5.5bn goes: hospital care, drugs, outpatient, dental, etc.

tools.name: judiciaryBudget
tools.description: The judiciary's budget by spending body — what the courts, the prosecution, the supreme courts, the ВСС and the inspectorate get, and how much of its costs the judiciary self-funds from court fees.

tools.name: judiciaryCaseload
tools.description: The movement of cases through Bulgaria's courts — filed, resolved and pending, clearance rate and the share closed within the 3-month deadline, by court tier.

tools.name: riverbedCleaning
tools.description: Public procurement for cleaning, regulating and reinforcing riverbeds and gullies — by awarder (municipalities, regional governors, Irrigation Systems), by year and largest contracts.

tools.name: judiciaryWorkload
tools.description: Judges' workload by court tier — both official measures: per allocated post, and actual (per person-month worked).

tools.name: judiciaryCourtLoad
tools.description: Actual workload of an INDIVIDUAL court — cases to consider and resolved per judge per month. Which court is busiest; a named court's or city's load.

tools.name: judiciaryDeclarations
tools.description: Magistrates' asset declarations — an index of the Inspectorate's register (who filed and when) plus its lists of late filers and unresolved discrepancies. Does not include the contents of the declarations.

tools.name: defenseSpending
tools.description: Bulgaria's defence spending as a share of GDP against the NATO targets (2% → 5% by 2035), plus the equipment-vs-personnel split.

tools.name: armsExports
tools.description: Bulgaria's defence-product exports by year — the record post-2022 surge and direct exports to Ukraine (Ministry of Economy figures).

tools.name: defenseProgram
tools.description: Bulgaria's flagship defence programs (F-16, Stryker, patrol ships, ammunition plant) — value, scope and status. These deals are via US FMS and not in the procurement register.

tools.name: defenseReadiness
tools.description: Bulgarian Army readiness — unfilled established posts, reserve fill and the personnel-vs-capital budget split.

tools.name: securityRoadSafety
tools.description: Road-traffic deaths in Bulgaria by year (Eurostat) — the outcome МВР's traffic police (КАТ) and patrol-car procurement are meant to improve.

tools.name: transportSpending
tools.description: State transport procurement (МТС, НКЖИ, БДЖ, ports, aviation) by mode and function, with competition. Railways dominate. Roads (АПИ) are a separate sector.

tools.name: transportEuFunds
tools.description: EU funds for transport (ИСУН) — contracted vs actually paid (absorption) by beneficiary (НКЖИ, БДЖ, ports). Shows how much money is actually drawn down.

tools.name: railSubsidy
tools.description: The state rail subsidy — how much the state pays per БДЖ passenger (PSO), the total subsidy (БДЖ + НКЖИ) and how it is rising. Answers who pays for the railway.

tools.name: socialSpending
tools.description: The social-assistance group's procurement (МТСП, АСП, Employment Agency, ГИТ) by function and competition. Procurement is ~1% of the budget — the household benefits are separate (socialBenefits). Pensions (НОИ) are a separate view.

tools.name: socialBenefits
tools.description: The benefits the Agency for Social Assistance (АСП) pays households — child allowances, disability support, targeted heating aid, guaranteed minimum income: amount and number of recipients. National/annual.

tools.name: socialPovertyImpact
tools.description: Do social transfers reduce poverty in Bulgaria and how it compares with the EU — at-risk-of-poverty before vs after transfers (Eurostat ilc_li10/ilc_li02). Bulgaria cuts poverty by ~27% vs the EU's ~33%.

tools.name: mrrbSpending
tools.description: The МРРБ group's procurement (the ministry, the cadastre agency АГКК, ДНСК and the 28 regional governors) by function and competition. Procurement is ~€100M — a thin slice of the ~€1.06bn budget; the rest is transfers and cohesion. Roads (АПИ) and water (ВиК) are separate sectors.

tools.name: cohesionAbsorption
tools.description: Absorption of the regional cohesion funds — ОПРР „Региони в растеж“ 2014-2020 (closed, ~96%) vs Programme „Развитие на регионите“ 2021-2027 (~20%): contracted, paid and absorption %. Expenditure is eligible until 31 December 2029 (Art. 63(2) of Reg. (EU) 2021/1060), and the n+3 rule (Art. 105) forfeits unspent money tranche by tranche each year for the 2021-2026 commitments.

tools.name: regionalInvestment
tools.description: EU funds (ИСУН) by oblast — per capita and total, where the money for the regions lands. All ИСУН funds, attributed by municipality and aggregated to oblast. The capital is inflated by nationally-run programmes headquartered there.

tools.name: environmentSpending
tools.description: Procurement of the state environment system (МОСВ, ИАОС, ПУДООС, national parks, НИМХ, river-basin directorates, the 16 РИОСВ) by unit and function, with competition. ИАОС — which measures the air — is nearly the size of the whole ministry.

tools.name: environmentFunds
tools.description: EU funds under ОП/Programme „Околна среда“ (ИСУН) — contracted vs actually paid (absorption). ОПОС 2014-2020 closed at ~95%, while Programme „Околна среда“ 2021-2027 sits near ~18% — the absorption risk.

tools.name: wasteRecycling
tools.description: Bulgaria's municipal-waste recycling rate against the EU targets (55% by 2025, 65% by 2035). BG peaked at ~35% in 2020 then fell to 16.7% (2023) — far below the target and the EU average.

tools.name: defensePeerCompare
tools.description: Defence spending as a share of GDP — Bulgaria vs its neighbours (Romania, Greece), Hungary, Croatia and the NATO Europe average. Answers “is 2% a lot”.

tools.name: generationMix
tools.description: Bulgaria's electricity generation mix by source (nuclear, coal, renewables), net electricity exports and carbon intensity — from Ember data.

tools.name: electricityPrices
tools.description: The household electricity price in Bulgaria vs the EU average (all taxes, EUR/kWh) — from Eurostat.

tools.name: gasPrices
tools.description: The household natural-gas price in Bulgaria vs the EU average and neighbours (all taxes, EUR/kWh) — from Eurostat (nrg_pc_202).

tools.name: powerPlants
tools.description: Bulgaria's power plants — coal, nuclear, hydro, gas and renewables — with capacity and ownership (state vs private). Answers 'how many coal plants' and 'who owns them'.

tools.name: nzokDrugs
tools.description: Which medicines the NHIF reimburses most — gross spend by active substance (INN); oncology dominates.

tools.name: nzokDrugGrowth
tools.description: Fastest-rising and newly-reimbursed NHIF medicines — year-over-year change by active substance (two closed years).

tools.name: nzokHospitals
tools.description: Which hospitals the NHIF pays most — inpatient-care (БМП) payments, cumulative year-to-date.

tools.name: nzokActivities
tools.description: Most frequent NHIF-funded procedures — clinical pathways and ambulatory/clinical procedures by number of cases (volume, not value).

tools.name: nzokDrugSavings
tools.description: How much the NHIF could save on medicines if every hospital paid the median price for the same pack — the national figure plus a ranking of the hospitals overpaying most above the median.

tools.name: nzokHospitalScorecard
tools.description: How one hospital compares to its peers — its financial indicators (occupancy, length of stay, cost per patient, overdue liabilities…) above / around / below the national median, plus whether it is paid more or less than its case-mix predicts. Name a hospital (e.g. Pirogov, Sveti Georgi Plovdiv).

tools.name: nzokPathwayHospitals
tools.description: Which hospitals bill a given clinical pathway and how many cases each — e.g. haemodialysis, childbirth, stroke. Name a pathway by name or code; also shows value (cases × НРД list price) when tariffs are loaded.

tools.name: nzokPublicPrivate
tools.description: Public vs private hospitals: how НЗОК money splits by ownership (state/municipal/private), what share of private hospitals are >50% publicly funded, and how many run no public tenders — the EC lawsuit against Bulgaria.

tools.name: nzokPrivateHospitals
tools.description: Private hospitals ranked by annual revenue (ГФО from the Commerce Register), or the list of >50%-publicly-funded private hospitals that run zero public tenders. Use filter=notenders for the latter.

tools.name: nzokDrugMolecule
tools.description: Which hospitals pay above the median price for the same medicine (pack) — per-molecule (INN) overpay versus peers. Name a molecule (e.g. BEVACIZUMAB) for the per-hospital breakdown, or omit for the most-overpaid medicines.

tools.name: procurementTotals
tools.description: Public procurement totals (AOP).

tools.name: topContractors
tools.description: Largest public-procurement contractors by total value, flagging the MP-tied ones (AOP).

tools.name: procurementAppeals
tools.description: КЗК appeals against public procurement — how many, how many upheld/rejected, and which buyers get appealed most. “Upheld” = the buyer's decision was annulled.

tools.name: contractSearch
tools.description: A specific contractor's public-procurement contracts — value, awarder, bid count and a link to each contract. Takes a company name or EIK, optionally a year.

tools.name: procurementRedFlags
tools.description: Public-procurement red flags: single-supplier spend concentration and debarred suppliers (AOP).

tools.name: procurementDebarred
tools.description: Debarred suppliers — companies currently barred from public procurement (АОП "Стопански субекти с нарушения" register).

tools.name: procurementSingleBidSectors
tools.description: Sectors (CPV divisions) where a single bidder is the market norm, so the single-bidder red flag is suppressed.

tools.name: mpProcurement
tools.description: Public procurement going to companies tied to the political class — MPs plus mayors, councillors, ministers and regional governors; for a named person, broken down by year.

tools.name: awarderProcurement
tools.description: Public procurement for one contracting authority (institution) — how much it spent, its largest suppliers and by-year trend. Covers the small buyers (schools, kindergartens) from the ЦАИС ЕОП feed.

tools.name: procurementNormalcy
tools.description: How normal is one public contract vs similar ones? Positions a single contract (by its 12-char id) against a cohort of similar procurements — value, bidder count, procedure type and share of the buyer. Descriptive, not a finding of wrongdoing.

tools.name: roadsSpending
tools.description: Road Infrastructure Agency (АПИ) procurement spending on roads and motorways — by kind of work (tunnels, bridges, markings, safety barriers…) with single-bid share, largest corridors, cost per kilometre, by year and largest contractors.

tools.name: openTenders
tools.description: Announced public-procurement tenders (PROCEDURES, estimated/forecast value — before any signed contract). Searches the WHOLE corpus by keyword/topic AND by year — answers 'show all tenders for X in YEAR' (e.g. road guardrails, asphalt). With no filters returns the biggest live tenders; optionally for one buyer. Shows estimated value, lot count, status (announced/cancelled).

tools.name: tenderLookup
tools.description: Details of one announced tender (procedure) by its unique number (УНП, e.g. 00044-2025-0125) or by keyword: estimated value, lots, status and the lineage to a signed contract. The estimated value is a FORECAST, not money spent.

tools.name: openCalls
tools.description: Open EU-funds calls — what you can APPLY FOR right now: deadline, budget, eligible applicants. Basis: ИСУН 2020 (the 2021-2027 programmes + the Recovery Plan) and the ДФЗ CAP Strategic-Plan indicative schedule. NOT the awarded-contracts corpus (that is fundsOverview / fundsProjects), and NOT Interreg (which runs in Jems). Reports expected intakes (a month range, not a deadline) and draft guidance out for consultation as separate counts.

tools.name: fundsOverview
tools.description: Rank beneficiary organisations by EU funding received (ISUN). For overall absorption or programme rankings use fundsProjects.

tools.name: projectLifecycle
tools.description: Curated project file (Наясно) — contracted total, how it was awarded (open tender / no open tender / method unstated) and top contractors for one public project (e.g. Hemus, machine voting). Lists the available files when called with no argument.

tools.name: subsidiesOverview
tools.description: Farm subsidies (State Fund Agriculture, CAP) — total paid, recipient count, concentration and top recipients by financial year.

tools.name: subsidiesByScheme
tools.description: Farm subsidies by scheme/intervention (direct payments, market measures, rural development) — amount and share.

tools.name: subsidiesForEntity
tools.description: Farm subsidies for a specific company/recipient — total received, by year and by scheme (legal entities with an EIK only).

tools.name: cultureOverview
tools.description: State film subsidy (National Film Center) — total, project count, concentration and split by discipline (feature/documentary/animation), 2014–2025.

tools.name: topCultureGrantees
tools.description: Top-funded producers from the National Film Center — who wins the most state film subsidy.

tools.name: filmSubsidyForProducer
tools.description: State film subsidy for a specific producer — total and films from the НФЦ register.

tools.name: cultureGrantSuccess
tools.description: National Culture Fund grant success rate — how many applications get funded, by art field.

tools.name: cultureCommissions
tools.description: The НФЦ national artistic-commission compositions — who decides which film projects get a state subsidy (feature, documentary, animation).

tools.name: cultureMunicipal
tools.description: Municipal & community-centre culture — Sofia's „Култура“ programme (funded projects by direction) and the national subsidy for community centres (читалища).

tools.name: revenueBreakdown
tools.description: Tax-revenue breakdown — excise by product + import VAT + customs duties (Customs), domestic VAT by sector and PIT by income type (NRA).

tools.name: exciseRegister
tools.description: Licensed excise warehouse keepers (Customs Agency) — who is licensed to hold fuels, tobacco or alcohol under duty suspension, ranked by public procurement.

tools.name: exciseWarehouses
tools.description: Where the excise warehouses are (Customs Agency) — active bonded warehouses by city (count per city) with a category split; or the warehouse keepers in one town.

tools.name: fundsProjects
tools.description: EU funding absorption (ISUN): total contracted versus actually paid, and which programmes absorb the most. For beneficiary rankings use fundsOverview.

tools.name: municipalFiscalRanking
tools.description: Year-end municipal ranking across the Ministry of Finance's separate liability measures: commitments, expense obligations and arrears. NULL is unpublished, not zero.

tools.name: municipalTransfers
tools.description: State transfers to municipalities by type (Art. 53 of the State Budget Law) — delegated activities, equalization and capital subsidies, etc.

tools.name: govDebt
tools.description: Government debt — recent issuances (bonds, T-bills).

tools.name: noiFunds
tools.description: Social-security funds (NSSI) — revenue, expenditure, balance.

tools.name: noiPensionDistribution
tools.description: The pension-size distribution — how many pensioners get the minimum pension or less, how many sit at or above the cap, and where the poverty line falls. Shows why the average pension describes almost no one.

tools.name: noiPensionByOblast
tools.description: Average pension by oblast — the highest- and lowest-paying regions, the spread between them, and the share of pensions still drawn in cash rather than paid to a bank.

tools.name: noiPensionSeries
tools.description: Average wage, insurable income and pension over the years, with the replacement ratio (pension relative to wage). How the pension tracks incomes over time.

tools.name: kfnFunds
tools.description: Private pension funds (pillars 2 & 3, KFN) — total net assets and insured persons, a per-pillar split (universal/professional/voluntary/voluntary-occupational) and the biggest companies by assets (Doverie, Allianz, DSK, etc.).

tools.name: budgetExecution
tools.description: Monthly state-budget execution (revenue/expenditure/balance) over time.

tools.name: ministryBudget
tools.description: A specific ministry's or agency's budget by programme (incl. НАП and the Customs Agency).

tools.name: investmentProjects
tools.description: Investment programme (Appendix III) — largest capital projects.

tools.name: personProfile
tools.description: A person profile by name from the complete people registry: public figures and private people with company roles. An exact name opens directly; available details include offices, companies, candidacies, donations, sanctions and State Security records.

tools.name: personConnections
tools.description: A person's connected people: other public figures who co-own or co-manage a company with them (Commerce Registry). A name-match lead, not proof.

tools.name: personWealth
tools.description: A public figure's declared wealth over time: assets, debts and net worth by year, from their Court-of-Audit (Сметна палата) property declarations. Declared, not audited.

tools.name: governments
tools.description: Governments since 2005 — PMs, periods, parties.

tools.name: mpAssetsTop
tools.description: MPs ranked by declared assets.

tools.name: mpConnectionsTop
tools.description: MPs with the most business connections (Commerce Registry).

tools.name: mpAssetsByParty
tools.description: MP declared assets aggregated by party (average per MP).

tools.name: mpConnectionsByParty
tools.description: MP business connections aggregated by party.

tools.name: officialsAssetsTop
tools.description: Senior officials (cabinet, deputy ministers, governors) by declared assets.

tools.name: financingOverview
tools.description: Party financial reports — filing compliance (Court of Audit).

tools.name: partyFinance
tools.description: Campaign income and expenses for a specific party in an election (donations, own funds, media package; Court of Audit).

tools.name: companyProfile
tools.description: A company or organisation profile from the full Commerce Registry by name or EIK — legal form, status, registered seat, activity and available public-money records.

tools.name: companyConnections
tools.description: A company's connections (by EIK) to people in power — officers who hold public office or are one company-hop from an MP/official (Commerce Registry).

tools.name: macroIndicator
tools.description: A macro indicator over time (inflation, GDP, debt…).

tools.name: fdiFlows
tools.description: Foreign direct investment in Bulgaria (BNB monthly balance-of-payments flows — total, equity, reinvested earnings, debt + year-to-date).

tools.name: macroOverview
tools.description: Snapshot of key macro indicators.

tools.name: macroByCategory
tools.description: Indicators by theme: economy, fiscal, governance, society.

tools.name: euComparison
tools.description: Compare an indicator across Bulgaria, the EU-27 and CEE peers (Romania, Greece, Hungary, Croatia) over time.

tools.name: subnationalIndicator
tools.description: A per-município indicator over time (unemployment, DZI, migration).

tools.name: schoolMatura
tools.description: A specific school's state-matura (ДЗИ) Bulgarian-language average — score, graduates, national rank and socioeconomic context.

tools.name: rankPlaces
tools.description: Rank oblasts/municipalities by unemployment, matura, population, migration, GDP, mortality, hospital beds or transparency. For EU funds per capita use regionalInvestment; for basket cost relative to GDP use basketAffordability.

tools.name: regionIndicator
tools.description: A per-oblast (NUTS3) indicator: GDP/capita, population, migration.

tools.name: transparencyScore
tools.description: Local transparency index (LISI) for an oblast centre.

tools.name: localTaxes
tools.description: Local tax rates for a município vs the national average.

tools.name: landUse
tools.description: Land use by category (national or per oblast).

tools.name: priceIndex
tools.description: How much the consumer basket has risen since the euro (national or per oblast) — CPC monitoring index + by category. NOT official CPI.

tools.name: settlementPrices
tools.description: Retail prices in one place: basket change since the euro, lowest prices for staple products and the cheapest chain. Also a single product (e.g. milk).

tools.name: localDeals
tools.description: Current promotions (biggest per-product price cuts) — national or in one município. Promo vs regular price from the daily CPC feed.

tools.name: productPrice
tools.description: Price of a specific product across chains nationwide — resolves the exact product by name (e.g. Lavazza coffee, Bisser sunflower oil, Vereya milk) and shows which chains are cheapest and how it moved since the euro.

tools.name: cheapestChains
tools.description: Retail chains ranked by basket cost (national or in one município) — compared on the shared basket.

tools.name: priceRanking
tools.description: Places ranked by prices: cheapest towns/oblasts for the basket, or where prices rose most since the euro (list + map).

tools.name: basketAffordability
tools.description: Consumer-basket cost relative to regional GDP per capita (Eurostat). This is economic context, not a measure of household income or purchasing power.

tools.name: basketVsInflation
tools.description: The CPC basket (since the euro) vs official inflation (HICP — food, overall, energy, core; Eurostat). Different windows — context, not a like-for-like comparison.

tools.name: euFoodPriceLevels
tools.description: Bulgarian food prices vs the EU average — official Eurostat price level indices (EU=100) by category. Dairy & oils above the average, meat/bread/produce below.

tools.name: fuelPrices
tools.description: Fuel prices in Bulgaria vs the EU average — petrol 95 and diesel (incl. VAT, EUR/L), weekly from the EC Weekly Oil Bulletin. Bulgarian fuel is consistently below the EU average.

tools.name: chainProfile
tools.description: A retail chain's profile — its basket cost and rank among chains plus the public contracts it wins as a supplier (joins the price and procurement corpora by EIK).

tools.name: governanceProfile
tools.description: Composite place profile: population, mayor, council, turnout, unemployment, transparency, procurement.

tools.name: comparePlaces
tools.description: Compares two places across governance indicators (population, mayor, council, unemployment, transparency…).

tools.name: census
tools.description: Demographics (Census 2021): population, gender, ethnicity.

tools.name: procurementBySettlement
tools.description: Public procurement awarded in one settlement. A bare city name means the settlement; use procurementByOblast only for an explicit province/oblast request.

tools.name: myAreaAlerts
tools.description: Recent activity in one place — announced/awarded procurement + amendments, new and changed EU-funds projects, council resolutions, local elections.

tools.name: placeEuProjects
tools.description: EU-funds projects in one place — total contracted, paid, top projects, and new/changed contracts from the latest update.

tools.name: procurementByOblast
tools.description: Local public procurement rolled up to one oblast — total, per resident, average contract, buyer count and top settlements (AOP; national ministries excluded).

tools.name: airQuality
tools.description: Quarterly PM10/PM2.5 averages from stations in the municipality, or explicitly labelled stations elsewhere in its oblast.

tools.name: graoPopulation
tools.description: Registered population (GRAO) by permanent and current address.

tools.name: councilResolutions
tools.description: Municipal council resolutions (where indexed).

tools.name: problemSections
tools.description: Tracked Roma neighbourhoods ("controlled voting") — sections and leading party.

tools.name: romaVoteTrend
tools.description: Who wins the Roma vote over time — leading party in the watched neighbourhoods, by election.

tools.name: riskIndex
tools.description: Statistical election-risk screening index — a 0–100 score and 10 components. It flags anomalies; it does not establish misconduct or a crime.

tools.name: riskScore
tools.description: Section risk screening — sections by band (low/elevated/high/critical).

tools.name: riskClusters
tools.description: Risk clusters — adjacent flagged sections sharing a leading party.

tools.name: clusterPersistence
tools.description: Persistent risk loci — places whose risk clusters recur across elections.

tools.name: benfordAnomalies
tools.description: Benford's-law (first-digit) test per party — deviation in digit distribution.

tools.name: wastedVotes
tools.description: Wasted votes — share of votes for below-threshold parties, by oblast.

tools.name: wastedVotesTrend
tools.description: Wasted-votes trend — national share of below-threshold votes across elections.

tools.name: suspiciousSettlements
tools.description: Suspicious settlements — concentrated vote, invalid ballots, additional voters.

tools.name: diasporaVote
tools.description: Out-of-country vote (MIR 32) — results by party.

tools.name: diasporaVoteTrend
tools.description: Diaspora vote (MIR 32) trend — leading parties across elections (multi-line chart).

tools.name: voterPersistence
tools.description: Voter persistence — share of voters who stayed with the same party between two elections.

tools.name: partyDemographics
tools.description: A party's demographic correlations (Census 2021): ethnicity, religion, education, age.

tools.name: demographicCleavages
tools.description: Demographic cleavages — which metrics most divide the parties.

tools.name: mpLoyalty
tools.description: MP party loyalty — share of votes cast with the MP's group.

tools.name: mpAttendance
tools.description: MP attendance at roll-call votes.

tools.name: factionCohesion
tools.description: Faction cohesion — how uniformly the groups vote.

tools.name: mpVotingProfile
tools.description: An MP's roll-call profile by name: loyalty and attendance.

tools.name: mpSimilarity
tools.description: Which MPs vote most similarly to a given MP.

tools.name: voteSearch
tools.description: Search parliamentary votes by topic/keyword — outcome and tally.

tools.name: partyMps
tools.description: The MPs (members) of one party in the sitting National Assembly — by name.

tools.name: schoolScores
tools.description: Schools in a município by average matura (DZI) / NVO exam score.

tools.name: administrationOverview
tools.description: The state administration as an institution: positions, structures, vacancies, cost (COFOG), number of administrative services, service signals and e-government use vs the EU.

tools.name: digitalSkills
tools.description: Citizen digital skills vs the EU (Eurostat, DESI): share with at least basic skills, EU rank, young people 16-24, the gender gap and the skill areas.

tools.name: tourismSeasonality
tools.description: Bulgaria tourism seasonality — nights per month (foreign and domestic), summer/winter share and peak month. Source: Eurostat.

tools.name: tourismSourceMarkets
tools.description: Tourist source markets for Bulgaria — nights and share by country of origin (Romania, Germany, Ukraine…). Source: Eurostat.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
models.note: Production cloud router for the Наясно chat.

models.label: Gemma 4 31B (640-tok budget)
models.note: Open model (BgGPT base family). Gemma on the Gemini API has no system role / function-calling tools, so the ~107-tool list goes in one user turn and the JSON reply is parsed. CAVEAT (verified from raw output): no API failures (0/208 empty), but the ~49% that emit no valid JSON are NOT wrong-tool picks — they are verbose chain-of-thought TRUNCATED at the 640-token cap (88% of failures sit at the ceiling; 100% name the correct tool in their reasoning). So this row understates the model; see the 1536-tok row for the recovery. STALE (2026-06-07): measured against a 108-tool registry snapshot; the registry now holds 235+ tools and a re-measure hit a Gemini-API rate-limit wall on 2026-09-18 before it could complete. Read this row as a 108-tool-era reference point, not current.

models.label: Gemma 4 31B (1536-tok budget)
models.note: Same model + prompt as the 640-tok row, only the output budget raised to 1536 so the chain-of-thought can finish and emit the closing JSON. Result: routing jumps to EN 81% / BG 83% (from 54% / 50% at 640) — a ~28pt recovery, still 0 empty responses — confirming the 640 failures were CoT TRUNCATION, not wrong-tool picks. The BG<EN gap also REVERSES (BG was worse at 640 only because its longer CoT truncated more), so there is no real Bulgarian tool-selection penalty once the budget fits. STALE (2026-06-08): measured against a 108-tool registry snapshot; see the 640-tok row's note.

models.label: Jev (jev-latest, TypeSafe System One)
models.note: Not an LLM completion — a Choice question whose criteria map is the tool catalogue (+ a no_tool sentinel for irrelevance), evaluated directly by TypeSafe's Jev model. Returns the winning option plus a full probability distribution over every candidate and a calibrated confidence, so it cannot hallucinate a tool name outside the list. See docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/choice. Evaluated by ai/llm/fcEval.jev.ts, not the shared CompleteFn adapter, because this run also captures per-call latency, token usage and confidence calibration that the generic string-return interface would discard.

models.label: FunctionGemma 270M — baseline (k=8, free)
models.note: Baseline: the published config — k=8 full JSON tool declarations, native FunctionGemma tokens, free (unconstrained) decoding.
models.reason: 0/214 in both languages — but raw output (see the capture's failureBreakdown) shows WHY: ~68% (146/214) trap with a wasm 'RuntimeError: unreachable' BEFORE emitting a token — the k=8 tool-declaration prompt (~2–3k chars, ~700–900 tokens) overflows this build's 512-token sliding-window KV cache at prefill ('KV cache is full'). The other ~32% run but emit degenerate output (empty {}, repeated tokens, hallucinated names); none is a coherent tool selection. So the 0/N is a context-window/runtime limit (can't process the prompt), NOT wrong-tool routing.

models.label: FunctionGemma 270M — fit prompt (k=3, free)
models.note: Lever 1 — shrink the candidate set to k=3 so the prompt (~700–1200 chars) fits the 512-token window.
models.reason: Fitting the prompt ELIMINATES the traps (0 engine-errors, vs 68% at k=8) — the model now runs on every case. But free decoding still yields ~1% correct: it hallucinates plausible-but-fake tool names (machine_comparison, election_results) and malformed JSON. Fitting the window is necessary but not sufficient.

models.label: FunctionGemma 270M — fit + grammar (k=3)
models.note: Lever 2 — constrain decoding (XGrammar / response_format) so the output MUST be {"name": <one of the k candidates>}.
models.reason: Grammar is the decisive lever: forcing a real candidate name lifts routing to 37% (80/214) — well above the ~33% chance for k=3 — with 100% valid JSON and 0 garbage. Errors are semantically adjacent (nationalResults→machineVoteSeries). NOTE: hard-constraining to the candidate enum means the model can no longer abstain, so off-topic ('call nothing') detection drops to 0 — production would add a 'no_tool' sentinel to the enum.

models.label: FunctionGemma 270M — route-among-8 (k=8 compact + grammar)
models.note: Lever 3 — compact {name, description} declarations let k=8 fit the window (~1.2k chars), with grammar. The realistic 'route among many' test.
models.reason: At k=8 (chance ~12.5%) the model still beats chance at 18% (39/214) with no traps — but a real EN>BG gap opens (EN ~23% vs BG ~13%), the bilingual degradation this eval was built to surface. Untuned, routing-among-many is above chance but far from usable; this is the gap a domain fine-tune must close.
